arguments.sql: SELECT o.order_date, SUM(ol.quantity * p.unit_price) FROM orders o JOIN order_lines ol ON o.id = ol.order_id JOIN products p ON ol.product_id = p.id WHERE o.id = 168 GROUP BY o.id
